sample_unit: videos from independent patients (test set); also 1318 normal and 915 abnormal images

links.outcome: AI accuracy compared with 8 endoscopists on same video test set
links.effect: System accuracy 85% vs endoscopists 77 ± 6% (p < 0.01); superior to novices and comparable to experts.
links.quote: For the video test set, the accuracy of the system was significantly better than that of the endoscopists (85% vs. 77 ± 6%, p < 0.01).

screen.reason: The study develops a deep learning CAD system for enteroscopy and compares its diagnostic performance on a video reader test against 8 endoscopists (novices and experts).
